seq.description: Counts up from 1 for each add-in load; a gap means events were missed.

kind.description: The event kind, for example document.saved.

time.description: When it was raised, UTC, ISO 8601.

missed.description: True when events after after_seq were lost: the add-in's sequence skipped, or the server dropped old ones.

last_seq.description: Pass this as after_seq next time; the sequence of the last event returned, or after_seq when none was.

more.description: True when more events matched than limit allowed.

process_id.description: The SOLIDWORKS process the events came from; absent before any connection.
